- Subprocessors & data flow: If you can indicate which data flows or endpoints you care about (embeddings, logs, model outputs, etc.), we'll prioritize questions accordingly.
- Timeline: We can return an initial completed SIG within ~5-7 business days once we know the scope. SOC2/pen test artifacts can be shared sooner as PDFs.

2) We provide redacted SOC2 and pen-test artifacts.
3) If useful, schedule a 30-minute follow-up with Logan (technical SE) to walk through architecture and encryption questions.

Thanks — I'll coordinate internal owners once you confirm preferred format.

Hi Camila —

Thanks for the follow-up and the starter file. A few clarifying questions from our side:

1) Preference: Our procurement team typically accepts a completed SIG Lite for most SaaS vendors, but for vendors handling PHI we may request the full SIG or a CAIQ + supporting artifacts. Given Redwood's model capabilities, we likely need the full SIG. Can you confirm you'll be able to complete the full SIG?

2) SOC 2: We will need the SOC 2 Type II report (redacted OK) and the SOC 2 bridge letter if available. Can you provide those?

3) Pen test: A one-page summary of the most recent penetration test (high/medium/low findings) is fine.

4) Encryption: We'll need confirmation on encryption at rest and in transit, KMS usage, and key management options for dedicated deployments.

5) Timeline: Would you be able to return the full SIG and artifacts within 7-10 business days? We have a compliance review session on Dec 15.

Also, could you copy your security contact or SE on the technical questions? We may want to set up a quick call.
